title: mentha × nemorosa subsp. dulcissima
intro: Mentha × nemorosa subsp. dulcissima, commonly known as Sweet Woodruff, is a fragrant, perennial herb native to Europe and parts of Asia. This plant is renowned for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to aid digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha × nemorosa subsp. dulcissima include its use in traditional medicine to ease respiratory issues, calm nervous system imbalances, and promote sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its distinctive sweet, herbal fragrance.
